exact_missing_items: Canonical event families must be: seam.*, package.*, node.*, promotion.*, corroboration.*, graph_patch.*, recovery.*, account.* — no surface-local shadow event language

Concern creation authority: runtime, package overseer, seam overseer, corroboration outcome, graph patch/state-transition logic may mint canonical concerns; workers may NOMINATE but not mint canonical concerns
Canonical event families must be shared between the runtime and UI projections — the Orchestrator must NOT invent a shadow event language separate from the runtime event model
Concern model must be a first-class record with fields: identity, scope, severity, category, owner, lifecycle state, meaning/summary, linkage to evidence/artifacts/history, visibility flags
Projection freshness model: event-driven updates are primary; each projection must carry one of these health states: current, refreshing, stale, failed
Projection degradation policy: a stale projection that undermines blocked/promotion/recovery/patch/account-pressure truth must mint a real concern — degraded projections are not silent
concern record = canonical durable object with stable identity and lifecycle
concern source event/ref = review finding, corroboration result, blocked episode, patch result, recovery outcome that supports the concern
concern projection = surface-specific rendering for Progress / Seams / Evidence / History / Ledger
review finding: may nominate a concern or attach evidence to an existing concern
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
